description: Elections Commission - R. V. Premathilaka, K. P. D. N. Jayasena, S. T. P. S. Kumara of the Kurunegala Pradeshiya Sabha has vacated his office of the member of Sri Lanka Podujana Peramuna
reasoning: This gazette contains multiple notices under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance declaring that specific individuals have vacated their office as members of the Kurunegala Pradeshiya Sabha due to ceasing membership in a political party. This content directly relates to electoral processes and the status of elected officials, falling under the Elections category (Type 7) which covers electoral matters including declarations about candidate status and vacancies.
